lead.event: IDX extends Wijaya Karya’s trading suspension over delayed bond and sukuk payments
lead.headline: IDX extends WIKA trading suspension over six delayed bond and sukuk payments
lead.blurb: Wijaya Karya shares will remain suspended across all markets until further notice after the company postponed six payments due 18 November. They comprise interest on three bond series and profit-sharing payments on three sukuk series. The IDX said the delays indicate problems with the company's business continuity.

other.event: PGN reviews the LCIA ruling in its Gunvor LNG dispute and considers further legal steps
other.headline: PGAS reviews US$128.6 million LCIA award in Gunvor dispute
other.blurb: PGN is reviewing a partial London Court of International Arbitration award ordering it to pay US$128.6 million for nine LNG cargoes after rejecting its force majeure claim. PGN is preparing further legal steps, and execution still requires an Indonesian district court.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Tabungan Negara reports higher nine-month profit and revises its 2026 growth targets
earnings_guidance.headline: BBTN reports 22.6% nine-month profit growth, revises 2026 targets
earnings_guidance.blurb: BTN raised its full-year loan growth target to 8%-11% from 8%-10%, while cutting its deposit growth target to 3%-5% from 7%-9%. The deposit target revision followed third-party fund growth of 3.8% year on year.

earnings_guidance.event: Astra International records foreign net buying as Kiwoom raises its price target
earnings_guidance.headline: ASII records Rp937 billion foreign net buying as Kiwoom raises price target
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astra International ranked second on the Indonesia Stock Exchange for foreign net buying in the regular market from 2–19 November, behind BBCA at Rp1.6 trillion. Kiwoom analyst Adrian Djie cited year-on-year net profit growth of 8% in automotive and 6% in financial services, supported by a recovery in domestic vehicle sales and growth in new financing.

earnings_guidance.event: Petrindo Jaya Kreasi targets first metallurgical coal sales by year-end 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: CUAN targets first metallurgical coal sales by end-2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Petrindo is completing infrastructure for its Daya Bumindo Karunia (DBK) mine, including hauling roads, stockpiles and logistics and port facilities. DBK is expected to contribute to revenue from late 2026, with profit contribution building as production and sales volumes rise.

earnings_guidance.event: Perusahaan Gas Negara reports 23% nine-month net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: PGAS reports 23% nine-month net profit growth to US$293 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Perusahaan Gas Negara's revenue rose about 3% to US$3 billion, while EBITDA increased around 8% to US$785 million. Gas trading volume fell to 827 BBTUD from 833 BBTUD, but LNG regasification volume climbed to 300 BBTUD from 254 BBTUD.

deals_control.event: Barki family transfers a 50% stake in Harum Energy in a Rp4.46 trillion transaction
deals_control.headline: Barki family transfers 50% stake in HRUM for Rp4.46 trillion
deals_control.blurb: IDX data showed 67.59 million lots of Harum Energy shares traded in a single negotiated-market transaction at Rp660 per share. HRUM also traded around Rp660 on the regular market, and no official explanation for the deal had been released by 19 November.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The Barki family transferred a 50% stake in HRUM.

deals_control.event: Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur divests Sintesa Bara Gemilang to fund business expansion
deals_control.headline: BIPI plans Rp1.79 trillion sale of Sintesa Bara Gemilang
deals_control.blurb: Indo Panca Borneo is the buyer, with completion targeted for December 2026. Astrindo plans to allocate around Rp1.3 trillion to LNG and gas, geothermal, data centers and waste-to-energy, and about Rp0.4 trillion to organic growth and ongoing projects. Astrindo says the sale will cut its debt by more than 50%.

deals_control.event: WIFI records a Rp4.06 trillion negotiated-market block trade
deals_control.headline: WIFI records Rp4.06 trillion negotiated-market block trade
deals_control.blurb: The trade involved 14.16 million lots at Rp2,870 per share, well above the regular-market price. Solusi Sinergi Digital’s regular-market shares rose 7.24% to Rp815, and no official explanation for the block trade had been released.

deals_control.event: Petrindo Jaya Kreasi invests in Tolu Minerals through a convertible note
deals_control.headline: CUAN invests AUD 23.75 million in Tolu convertible notes
deals_control.blurb: Petrindo made the investment through subsidiary Petrosea, which completed a binding offer on 20 April 2026. The notes can convert into 14.6 million new Tolu shares at AUD 1,625 each.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI's November review demotes BRMS and is followed by weak foreign stock inflows
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI demotes BRMS to Small Cap as year-to-date stock outflows hit Rp81.6 trillion
market_structure_policy.blurb: The November review removed Bumi Resources Minerals from the Global Standard Index and moved it to the Global Small Cap Index, effective 1 December. BI Governor Destry Damayanti said foreign inflows to equities had not recovered since MSCI announced the change on 12 November.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Foreign investors had withdrawn a net Rp81.6 trillion from Indonesian stocks year to date.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Adi Sarana Armada secures a Rp250 billion credit facility from Bank of China
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ASSA secures Rp250 billion credit facility from Bank of China
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Adi Sarana Armada signed a Committed Term Loan III on 19 November to fund working capital, including vehicle purchases for its rental business. The company expects the added fleet to boost revenue and business growth.
